After School at Providence Day School
Providence Day School (TK-12) - Charlotte, NC - Parent-Facing Deep Research Report
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Executive Summary
Providence Day's after-school offering is division-specific: a nationally recognized Extended Day
program for Lower School and a flexible drop-in Clubhouse for Middle School. The Lower School
program's national recognition and child-development framing are its standout features; the Middle
School Clubhouse addresses the harder-to-serve tween window with a supervised, social space.
Strengths
• Nationally recognized Lower School Extended Day with a development-focused, choice-based
approach.
• A dedicated Middle School drop-in model (Clubhouse) - not always offered by peers.
• Year-round continuity via Summer Programs.
Questions to Confirm on a Visit
• Extended Day hours, ratios, and cost; flexibility of scheduling.
• Clubhouse supervision model and hours.
• Options for Upper School students after dismissal.
• Availability of enrichment/club classes vs. care only.
Caveats
Based on PD's public after-school pages (2025-26). Confirm current hours, fees, and eligibility with the
school (see Sources).
Sources & Where to Verify
After School Options: https://www.providenceday.org/admissions/after-school-options
Extended Day (Lower School): https://www.providenceday.org/lower-school/extended-day
Clubhouse (Middle School): https://www.providenceday.org/middle-school/clubhouse
Summer Programs: https://summer.providenceday.org/

Providence Day - Extended Day & Clubhouse
Providence Day School (TK-12) - Charlotte, NC - Extended Day & Clubhouse
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
Extended Day - Lower School
PD describes its Extended Day Program as nationally recognized. Teachers actively promote the
social, emotional, and physical development of each child through nurturing relationships, flexible
scheduling, and choices reflecting each child's individual needs, interests, and abilities.
Clubhouse - Middle School
The Middle School Clubhouse is open to all Middle School students as a drop-in destination to catch up
with friends, study, unwind, play, and eat - a safe place to grow physically and emotionally while
navigating the opportunities and boundaries of the middle-school years.
What to Confirm
• Extended Day hours, daily/contract pricing, and latest pickup.
• Clubhouse hours and whether it is free-flow or requires sign-up.
• Any enrichment classes or after-school clubs beyond care.
Sources & Where to Verify

After School at Providence Day School
Providence Day School (TK-12) - Charlotte, NC - Program Overview
Compiled research note - Charlotte private school after-school programs. Prepared July 2026. Hours, ages, fees, and
registration details change yearly - verify with the school before relying on them.
At a Glance
Providence Day offers two main after-school options by division: a nationally recognized Extended
Day Program for Lower School students, and the Middle School Clubhouse, a drop-in space for
Middle Schoolers. Summer Programs round out the year-round options.
The Two Options
• Extended Day (Lower School) - nationally recognized; teachers actively promote each child's
social, emotional, and physical development through nurturing relationships, flexible scheduling, and
choice.
• Clubhouse (Middle School) - open to all Middle School students to drop in, catch up with friends,
study, unwind, play, and eat in a safe, supervised space.
Note
The public pages emphasize Lower and Middle School; families of Upper School students should ask
about supervised study or activity options after dismissal. Hours, fees, and registration are confirmed
with the school.
